headline: Friday Wrap weekly recap arrives — and the Commitment Cockpit retires.

items.prompt_template: I retired the Commitment Cockpit dashboard. The kanban surface (you owe / they owe / both stuck) is now folded into your daily Commitments scheduled chat, which carries inline action surfaces — strictly better than a snapshot-only dashboard. If you have the Cockpit pinned in your sidebar, you can leave it (it just won't refresh) or unpin it. No data lost.

I added Friday Wrap — your first weekly-rhythm scheduled chat. It fires 4 PM Fridays your local time and produces a 7-day cross-source recap saved as a document. To register it in your workspace, type `set up command room schedules`. Your existing scheduled tasks stay; Friday Wrap is added alongside. On first fire, Cowork will surface a one-time permission prompt — click Run Now to authorize.
